Start: 1110-12-04  
Add 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Add 1 more day = 211 days total.  

1110-12-04 + 211 days:  
December has 31 days → from Dec 4: 27 days left in Dec → 27 days used.  
211 − 27 = 184 days left.  
1111 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not 400).  
Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) = 181 days.  
184 − 181 = 3 days into July.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1111-07-04
